label: D1 after a reward, when the agent leans toward a1
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (94% of activation mass), and only when the reward input is on (in_rew==1: rate 21% vs 0.6%). It is strongly selective for the a1 side: it is active almost only when the upcoming choice is a1 (99.6% of mass), with the policy logit moderately in favour of a1 (choice in [2.78, 8.07): 95% of mass, never when choice is negative or above 8). (D1 & rewarded & upcoming a1) gives F1 0.60 and mass recall 0.94. Using the model own D1 policy logit (choice > 2.78) in place of the upcoming action gives dev F1 0.71, mass recall 0.90. I recorded that one: it uses no future variables, and the upcoming choice is something the agent computes itself. It does not fire at GO at all, never on a2-leaning steps, and almost never in the last 10 trials of an episode. A small D2 part (6% of mass) fires after an a1 choice leads rarely to S2. Magnitude decays across runs of consecutive a1 rewards (e.g. 1.00, 0.85, 0.65, 0.46, 0.27), and the unit stays off at high value (>8.1), so false positives are mostly long reward streaks where the agent is already confident. Precision is still incomplete.
